subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain this bounded transport-level recovery in addition to the shared reply-session self-heal proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both approaches are technically credible but establish recovery policy at different ownership layers, and source inspection alone cannot determine whether maintainers want layered resilience or one canonical shared mechanism.

options.title: Keep layered recovery
options.body: Land this Discord safeguard and treat the shared initializer as primary recovery, with the transport retry covering transient or still-exhausted conflicts.

options.title: Consolidate in shared core
options.body: Pause this PR and require the shared initializer to fully own conflict recovery and expose only a generic replayable failure contract to channels.

options.title: Land Discord first
options.body: Land the proven Discord fix now and revisit consolidation after the shared recovery PR's direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Keep layered recovery
recommendation.body: Land this Discord safeguard and treat the shared initializer as primary recovery, with the transport retry covering transient or still-exhausted conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent shared-session work contains the strongest available evidence about the lifecycle boundary and interaction between inner self-heal and outer transport recovery.
